# Aviix Media

> Video Editing & Content Creation Agency

Aviix Media is a specialized video editing agency helping creators and brands turn long-form content into viral, highly-engaging short clips and showreels.

## Core Services
- Video Editing & Post-Production
- Short-Form Content Creation (Reels, TikToks, Shorts)
- Storytelling & Retention Optimization
- Podcast Highlights & Brand Content

- Portfolio & Clips: https://aviixmedia.com/clips

- Contact & Booking: https://aviixmedia.com/contact
